title: Rethinking the Multilingual Reasoning Gap with Layer Swap
abstract: arXiv:2605.26735v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent reasoning Large Language Models produce a chain-of-thought (CoT) predominantly in English, even when prompted in non-English languages. Prior work suggests that forcing the CoT to remain in the input language (native reasoning) substantially degrades performance relative to allowing the model to reason in English before answering in the input language (English-pivoted reasoning). However, most studies of this native reasoning gap rely on inference-time interventions or limited native-language training data. We revisit this comparison at a larger scale and under comparable supervision. We construct long multilingual reasoning datasets across six languages (English, French, German, Spanish, Chinese and Swahili); fine-tune specialists in both native and English-pivoted regimes on top of Qwen/Qwen3-8B-Base, and evaluate across mathematics, science, general knowledge, and code. translated_title: 重新思考多语言推理差距：基于层交换的方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.26735v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：近期推理大语言模型即使在使用非英语提示时，其思维链（CoT）也主要以英语生成。先前研究表明，强制思维链保持输入语言（母语推理）相对于允许模型先用英语推理再用输入语言回答（英语枢轴推理）会显著降低性能。然而，大多数关于母语推理差距的研究依赖于推理时干预或有限的母语训练数据。我们在更大规模且监督条件相当的情况下重新审视这一比较。我们构建了涵盖六种语言（英语、法语、德语、西班牙语、中文和斯瓦希里语）的长篇多语言推理数据集；在Qwen/Qwen3-8B-Base基础上，分别微调母语和英语枢轴模式的专业模型，并在数学、科学、通用知识和代码领域进行评估。在此设置下，平均母语推理差距显著缩小。
tldr: 本文通过构建六种语言的长篇推理数据集并在可比监督下微调模型，发现母语推理与英语枢轴推理的性能差距显著缩小，挑战了先前认为母语推理必然大幅劣化的观点。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs long multilingual reasoning datasets across six languages and fine-tunes models under comparable supervision, showing that the native reasoning gap significantly shrinks, challenging prior claims of substantial native reasoning degradation.
